items.literal_en: I'm not going to do it anymore, Arknights! Start!
items.meaning_en: The user expresses a sudden shift in interest, abandoning a previous activity and announcing the start of a new one related to Arknights.
The user agrees with a prior comment about PVP balance issues, specifically mentioning low damage for Eileen and a request for team composition ideas for White Night.
